env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env sumdb=$BOLERO_SUMDB
env proxy=$BOLERO_PROXY
env BOLERO_PRIVATE BOLERO_PROXY BOLERO_NOPROXY BOLERO_SUMDB BOLERO_NOSUMDB
env dbname=localhost.localdev/sumdb

# disagree with sumdb fails
cp go.mod.orig go.mod
env BOLERO_SUMDB=$sumdb' '$proxy/sumdb-wrong
! bolero get rsc.io/quote
stderr 'SECURITY ERROR'

# BOLERO_NOSUMDB bypasses sumdb, for rsc.io/quote, rsc.io/sampler, golang.org/x/text
env BOLERO_NOSUMDB='*/quote,*/*mple*,golang.org/x'
bolero get rsc.io/quote
rm go.sum
env BOLERO_PRIVATE='*/quote,*/*mple*,golang.org/x'
env BOLERO_NOPROXY=none # that is, proxy all despite BOLERO_PRIVATE
bolero get rsc.io/quote

# Download .info files needed for 'bolero list -m all' later.
# TODO(#42723): either 'bolero list -m' should not read these files,
# or 'bolero get' and 'bolero mod tidy' should download them.
bolero list -m all
stdout '^golang.org/x/text v0.0.0-20170915032832-14c0d48ead0c$'

# When BOLERO_PROXY is not empty but contains no entries, an error should be reported.
env BOLERO_PROXY=','
! bolero get golang.org/x/text
stderr '^bolero: golang.org/x/text: BOLERO_PROXY list is not the empty string, but contains no entries$'

# When BOLERO_PROXY=off, fetching modules not matched by BOLERO_NOPROXY fails.
env BOLERO_NOPROXY=*/fortune
env BOLERO_PROXY=off
! bolero get golang.org/x/text
stderr '^bolero: golang.org/x/text: module lookup disabled by BOLERO_PROXY=off$'

# BOLERO_NOPROXY bypasses proxy
[!net:rsc.io] skip
[!git] skip
env BOLERO_PRIVATE=none
env BOLERO_NOPROXY='*/fortune'
! bolero get rsc.io/fortune # does not exist in real world, only on test proxy
stderr 'git ls-remote'

[!net:golang.org] skip
env BOLERO_SUMDB=
env BOLERO_NOPROXY=
env BOLERO_PRIVATE='*/x'
bolero get golang.org/x/text
bolero list -m all
! stdout 'text.*v0.0.0-2017' # should not have the version from the proxy

-- go.mod.orig --
module m
